name: repro-doctor
description: Sandboxed repair agent for unfamiliar TypeScript repositories, verified by a hidden semantic oracle.

scripts.eval: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/index.js eval
scripts.report: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/index.js report
scripts.fixtures:verify: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/index.js fixtures verify
scripts.fixtures:patches: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli/index.js fixtures patches
